title: The NRI's Guide to World Cup 2026 at Levi's Stadium, San Francisco Bay Area
excerpt: Match schedule, the Bay Area's legendary desi food corridor, transit by VTA and Caltrain, fan zones, and how the heart of Silicon Valley's Indian community can make the most of the World Cup.
body:
If you're an NRI in the Bay Area, you already live in one of the most vibrant desi communities in America — and now the World Cup is literally down the street. Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara hosts 6 matches, and the Sunnyvale-Santa Clara-Milpitas desi corridor is minutes from the action.

## Match Schedule

| Date | Match | Kickoff (PT) |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Sat, Jun 13 | Qatar vs Switzerland | 12:00 PM |
| Tue, Jun 16 | Austria vs Jordan | 9:00 PM |
| Fri, Jun 19 | Turkey vs Paraguay | 8:00 PM |
| Mon, Jun 22 | Jordan vs Algeria | 8:00 PM |
| Wed, Jun 25 | Paraguay vs Australia | 7:00 PM |
| Wed, Jul 1 | Round of 32 (TBD) | TBD |

## Where to Eat: Silicon Valley's Desi Paradise

The Bay Area doesn't just have good Indian food — it has arguably the best Indian food scene in the United States, and it's all within 15 minutes of Levi's Stadium.

**Sunnyvale & Santa Clara (5-15 min from stadium):** UlavacharU on El Camino Real has the best Andhra buffet — unlimited chai and mango lassi. Madurai Idli Kadai on Wolfe Road is a hole-in-the-wall legend for ghee podi masala dosa. Surmai for Maharashtrian coastal seafood and Malvani fish thalis. Delhiwala Chaat for the best chole bhature in the Bay Area. And Tandoori Pizza stays open until 4 AM — perfect for post-match celebrations.

**Milpitas (15-20 min):** Hashtag India has jail-themed vibes and Hyderabadi dum biryani. Annapoorna is the first authentic Marathi restaurant in the Bay Area — vada pav, misal pav, and pav bhaji that'll transport you to Mumbai.

**Fremont (25-30 min):** Large South Asian population with great chaat spots and also home to "Little Kabul" — the largest Afghan community in the US.

## Getting There: Take the Train

**VTA Light Rail (Best option):** Take the Orange or Green Line to Great America Station, which is directly adjacent to the stadium. From Downtown San Jose (Diridon Station), it's just 20 minutes. Cost: ~$3 one-way.

**Caltrain + VTA (From SF/Peninsula):** Caltrain from SF (4th & King) to Santa Clara Station, then VTA shuttle to the stadium. About 70-80 minutes total.

**Pro tip:** Get a Clipper Card at SFO or SJC airport immediately. It works on BART, Muni, Caltrain, and VTA. **Do not drive** — parking is $95-$150 on match days and post-match traffic on 101 and 237 is brutal. VTA is genuinely faster.

**Fly into SJC, not SFO** if you're traveling for matches. San Jose airport is 10 minutes from the stadium vs. 45+ miles from SFO.

## Where to Stay

**Downtown San Jose:** The smart play. VTA Light Rail direct to the stadium in under 20 minutes. Hotels at $200-350/night on match weekends. Close to the San Pedro Square fan zone.

**Santa Clara:** Walking distance to the stadium. Hyatt Regency, Hilton, and Marriott all here. Near Santana Row for shopping and dining.

**Sunnyvale:** The ultimate NRI home base. Maximum desi food, grocery stores, and cultural familiarity. Murphy Ave is a hub with dozens of Indian restaurants within walking distance.

## Fan Zones & Watch Parties

The Bay Area has 30+ free fan zones. The **Soccer Celebration at San Pedro Square** in San Jose is the main hub — it's the only venue showing all 104 matches, free with RSVP. The **Sunnyvale World Soccer & Food Fest** (Jun 20-21) is in the heart of desi Sunnyvale and is perfectly timed between match days.

**FIFA Pop-Up Shop** at Santana Row runs Jun 10 through Jul 19 for official merch.

## Desi Community

**Naga Sai Temple** in Santa Clara is the closest temple to the stadium (~5 minutes). **Patel Brothers** at 2039 El Camino Real has everything for an Indian grocery run. The stretch along Murphy Ave and Old San Francisco Road in Sunnyvale is the Bay Area's unofficial Little India — walking down it genuinely feels like being in India.

## Tickets

Available at [FIFA.com/tickets](https://www.fifa.com/fifaplus/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/tickets). The Qatar vs Switzerland opener (Jun 13) is the most affordable. Book early — these will go fast with the Bay Area tech crowd.
